title_jp: ヴァンパイアシャッターチャンス
synopsis: A Tsukihime Remake slice-of-life doujinshi set in a relaxed timeline based on the Arcueid route. Shiki gifts Arcueid a disposable camera to keep her entertained during the day. While built on the Shiki and Arcueid dynamic, the story follows Arcueid wandering the city on her own with a camera, discovering daily human life and reflecting on her feelings for Shiki.
